title: Stir Fry with Argentinian Beef
description: A Thai inspired stir fry with tender argentinian beef, juicy aromatics, and a savory umami sauce.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sliced beef to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until browned.
3. Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
4. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
5. Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the skillet, and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
6. Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet, and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
7. Add the cooked beef back into the skillet, and stir in the umami sauce and stir fry seasoning.
8. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
9. Serve the stir fry hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
